notes: PTQ1_0 is the smallest packing of the same 1.88B model, not a separate smaller-parameter model.
Official README recommends PQ2_0 as default; PTQ1_0 for minimum file size; Q2_0 for upstream llama.cpp b11556+.
The 430 MB artifact contains language-model weights only; the vision projector is separate.
Artifact acquisition is not target-host installation or proof of runtime compatibility.
